name: @ahpd/bot
description: Bots for the ahpd daemon: a bot: resource provider, where a bot is a record with a workspace and a session
author: Luiz Fernando Softov <lfs@softov.dev>

ahpd.title: Bot
ahpd.description: Creates conversational bots with individual identities, workspaces, and persistent sessions.

root.description: The folder a bot's own workspace is under, as <root>/<slug>.

mainTurnPostMessageAbsent.description: What a main turn does when the back session's turn ends without post_message: post (the default), notice, silence or postNotice.

instructionsIn.description: Where a bot's instructions are in its AGENTS.md: its ## Instructions section (the default), or the whole body after the frontmatter, as VS Code reads an agent file.

contextIn.description: Where a woken message's context goes: a block in front of the person's words naming the main chat, the person and the time (text, the default), or the words as said with the main chat in the message's delegation _meta alone, as VS Code delegates a prompt (meta).
